name: Zichri
overview: Zichri is a male member of the tribe of Levi, uniquely identified as the son of Izhar. His lineage places him within the Levitical family, a tribe set apart for priestly duties and service to God. No additional personal notes are recorded about him in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Zichri means 'YHWH remembers,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning rooted in the Hebrew language. This proper name highlights God's faithfulness and remembrance, although it was not given directly by God according to the record in Exodus 6:21.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Zichri is the son of Izhar, establishing his immediate paternal relationship. Beyond this, no further family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zichri’s significance lies primarily in his identification as a Levite and a descendant of Izhar, situating him within the priestly lineage entrusted with sacred duties. His name, meaning 'YHWH remembers,' subtly points to God's covenant faithfulness, which is central to the Levitical heritage. While the biblical record does not elaborate on his personal deeds, his inclusion in the genealogy underscores the continuity of God's chosen people through faithful generations.
